title: Ride along with the object cameras
rationale: Six matched-size frames show how the available views frame different vehicle parts. The matched sling clip shows the rotor and suspended vehicle in motion from both camera heights.
source_ref: Native Metal capture, 1600x900, seed 712, 30 fps; frames sampled at 6, 23, 28, 33, 42.3 and 54 seconds.

sources.caption: Behind, aerial, track, roof gun, barrel and engine deck cameras.
Same sling scenario, seed 3, at 15.6 to 18.9 seconds. The previous F9 Sling load camera is on the left and the lower camera is on the right.
The rotor and its shadow at the same game frame.
